# US Bancorp (USB) Deep Dive Analysis

Report 045 | Published 2021-01-17 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2021-1-17/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/045.json)

Tactical caution, inflation and US Bancorp.

The strongest calls had clear variables: rising inflation, a Q1 dollar rebound and lower real-yield lows. General defensive timing was less successful. Bank analysis needs a sharper distinction between liquidity, capital and duration risk.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

- [Review of Silicon Valley Bank supervision: key takeaways](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/2023-April-SVB-Key-Takeaways.htm) | Federal Reserve | 2023-04-28 | Verified in the audit

SVB failed to manage interest-rate and liquidity risk, focused on short-run profits and protection against falling rates, and removed hedges. The failure demonstrates that rate risk can rapidly become a solvency/liquidity problem.

### 045-C23

**Cash assets establish bank capital**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Mixed |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | US bank resilience |
| Source blocks | 149 |

The Fed stress tests supported aggregate resilience, but cash and Treasuries are assets rather than equity capital. Liquid assets and loss-absorbing capital must be evaluated separately; low credit risk does not remove duration risk.

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [December 2020 bank stress tests](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/2020-december-dodd-frank-act-stress-test-executive-summary.htm) | Federal Reserve | 2020-12-18 | Verified in the audit

Aggregate CET1 was 12.2% in Q2, falling to modeled minima 9.6% and 9.7% under two adverse scenarios. Increased loss reserves reduced subsequent required provisions. This measures capital separately from holdings of liquid assets.

- [How money is created](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/explainers/how-is-money-created) | Bank of England | 2019-10-01 | Verified in the audit

Reserves are electronic central-bank settlement money. Capital is a separate resource that absorbs loan-default losses; both liquidity and capital constraints apply to banks.

- [Review of Silicon Valley Bank supervision: key takeaways](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/2023-April-SVB-Key-Takeaways.htm) | Federal Reserve | 2023-04-28 | Verified in the audit

SVB failed to manage interest-rate and liquidity risk, focused on short-run profits and protection against falling rates, and removed hedges. The failure demonstrates that rate risk can rapidly become a solvency/liquidity problem.

- [Review of Silicon Valley Bank supervision: key takeaways](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/2023-April-SVB-Key-Takeaways.htm) | Federal Reserve | 2023-04-28 | Verified in the audit

SVB failed to manage interest-rate and liquidity risk, focused on short-run profits and protection against falling rates, and removed hedges. The failure demonstrates that rate risk can rapidly become a solvency/liquidity problem.
